description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Extension_DeliveryLog_RawBucketProcessingStrategyPgsql, which implements data migration and pruning strategies for raw data buckets in a distributed OpenX (Revive Adserver) environment, specifically for PostgreSQL.

classes.name: OX_Extension_DeliveryLog_RawBucketProcessingStrategyPgsql
classes.description: Implements data migration and pruning for raw buckets in PostgreSQL for OpenX/Revive Adserver.

methods.name: processBucket
methods.description: Processes a raw data bucket up to a specified end date, migrating data in chunks.

methods.name: pruneBucket
methods.description: Prunes (deletes) data records up to a specified end date, optionally within a start date.

methods.name: getBucketTableContent
methods.description: Retrieves table content as a recordset up to a specified end date.
